title: KYC & AML Policy
description: MoneyCash's framework for customer identification, due diligence, fraud prevention, and anti-money-laundering controls.
registeredOffice: CREDSOLVE Technologies Private Limited, Flat No. E-2748, Gaur Siddhartham, Siddharth Vihar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh — 201009

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: This Know Your Customer ("KYC") and Anti-Money Laundering ("AML") Policy establishes the framework adopted by MoneyCash for customer identification, verification, due diligence, fraud prevention, anti-money laundering controls, and regulatory compliance.
The objective of this Policy is to:
Prevent MoneyCash from being used for money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, identity theft, or other unlawful activities.
Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
Support lending partners in conducting customer due diligence.
Establish a risk-based approach to customer onboarding and monitoring.

MoneyCash acts as a Lending Service Provider ("LSP") and conducts customer onboarding, identity verification, and related activities on behalf of regulated lending institutions including Aasra Fincorp Pvt. Ltd.

sections.title: Regulatory Framework
paragraphs: This Policy is based on the requirements of:
- RBI Master Direction – Know Your Customer (KYC) Directions, 2016 (as amended)

sections.title: Scope
paragraphs: - All customers and applicants using MoneyCash services.
- Third-party service providers engaged by MoneyCash.

sections.title: Definitions
paragraphs: Any individual applying for or availing loan products through the MoneyCash platform.
The process of identifying and verifying the identity of a customer.
Measures undertaken to verify customer identity, assess risks, and understand the nature of the customer's activities.
Measures designed to prevent money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and financial crimes.
Politically Exposed Person as defined under applicable regulations.
Any transaction that appears unusual, inconsistent, or indicative of criminal activity.

sections.title: KYC Principles
paragraphs: - Every customer is properly identified and verified.
- KYC is completed prior to loan disbursement.
- Customer information is accurate and current.
- Regulatory requirements are fully complied with.

sections.title: Customer Identification Program (CIP)
paragraphs: Before facilitating any loan application, MoneyCash shall collect and verify customer identity information.

sections.title: Officially Valid Documents (OVDs)
paragraphs: Acceptable identity and address documents may include:
- Any other document permitted under RBI KYC Directions

sections.title: KYC Verification Methods
paragraphs: MoneyCash may facilitate KYC verification using one or more of the following methods:
- Customer information may be verified through the Central KYC Registry (CKYCR).
Where required by the lending partner, Video-based Customer Identification Process (V-CIP) may be conducted in accordance with RBI regulations.
Verification may be conducted through authorized KYC service providers approved by the lending partner.

sections.title: Customer Due Diligence (CDD)
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall facilitate Customer Due Diligence prior to loan disbursement.
- Loan processing shall not proceed until required due diligence is completed.

sections.title: Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD)
paragraphs: Enhanced Due Diligence may be performed for customers classified as higher risk.
- Cases flagged by fraud detection systems
- Additional documentation or verification may be requested before processing.

sections.title: AML Monitoring Framework
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall maintain systems and controls designed to identify suspicious activities.

sections.title: Sanctions Screening
paragraphs: Applications associated with sanctioned individuals or entities may be declined and reported where required.

sections.title: Politically Exposed Persons (PEP)
paragraphs: PEPs may be identified through screening tools and due diligence procedures.
- Higher monitoring standards may apply to PEP relationships.

sections.title: Suspicious Activity Monitoring
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall monitor and investigate indicators of suspicious activity including:
Where suspicious activity is identified, appropriate action may be taken including suspension, rejection, escalation, or reporting.

sections.title: Record Retention
paragraphs: Customer records shall be retained in accordance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
Such records shall be retained for the period prescribed under PMLA, RBI regulations, and other applicable laws.

sections.title: Data Protection and Confidentiality
paragraphs: Customer information shall be protected through appropriate technical and organizational safeguards.

sections.title: Employee Responsibilities
paragraphs: - Failure to comply with this Policy may result in disciplinary action.

sections.title: Compliance Oversight
paragraphs: - Periodic audits and reviews shall be conducted to ensure effectiveness of controls.

sections.title: Customer Consent
paragraphs: Prior to conducting KYC verification, MoneyCash shall obtain customer consent for:

sections.title: Regulatory Disclosure
paragraphs: MoneyCash acts solely as a Lending Service Provider (LSP) and facilitates customer onboarding, KYC verification, and loan servicing activities on behalf of regulated lending institutions including Aasra Fincorp Pvt. Ltd.

Final KYC acceptance, customer onboarding approval, loan sanction, disbursement, and regulatory compliance obligations remain the responsibility of the lending partner in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
